## The Harbor Table — voice agent API
One POST webhook for the Dograh voice agent. Each Dograh HTTP tool sends a preset `action` plus the caller details it collected.

Every reply is HTTP 200 with `{ success, message, ... }`. `message` is written to be spoken aloud as-is.

Data lives in the 7 `restaurant demo - ...` data tables. Edit menu, hours, slots and specials there; no workflow changes needed.
